meta.title: Crop calendars - Maharashtra, India

conventions.dates: MM-DD; crop windows crossing new year have end < start (e.g. 12-15 to 02-15)
conventions.week_to_date: 1st week=01-07, 2nd week=08-14, 3rd week=15-21, 4th/last week=22-end of month; 1st fortnight=01-15, 2nd fortnight=16-end; month-only text uses full month(s)
conventions.seed_rate_kg_ha: number or {min,max}; per-acre figures converted with 1 ha = 2.471 acre (noted in seed_rate_text)
conventions.null: null = not found in consulted sources (never estimated)
conventions.region_keys: 'all' = state-wide SAU/ICAR guidance; '<region>_<district>' = district contingency plan (sec 1.12 'normal sowing window'); several 'all_*' keys hold alternative sources for comparison

caveats: ICAR-CRIDA district contingency plans date from 2011 and give 'normal' windows, not always crop-variety-specific; Bt-specific guidance is from CICR/MPKV.
MPKV Krishi Darshani 2026 is in Marathi with legacy fonts; values were read from rendered page images (PDF page numbers given) and translated.

MPKV guidance mainly targets Western Maharashtra, Khandesh and the scarcity zone; Vidarbha (PDKV), Marathwada (VNMKV) and Konkan (BSKKV) SAU packages were not directly available except PDKV recommendations and CRIDA plans prepared with those SAUs.

sowing_window.text: Rainfed: dry sowing 7-8 days before expected monsoon in 1st/2nd week of June (not on light soils or where waterlogging/heavy weeds); otherwise sow as soon as adequate Mrig-nakshatra rain is received in 2nd or 3rd week of June; if monsoon is late sow up to 1st week of July (with shorter-duration varieties, reduced spacing and ~20% higher seed rate).

all.spacing_cm: Bt (rainfed): 90 x 60 (medium soil, 18,500 plants/ha); 90 x 90 (heavy soil, 12,300 plants/ha)
all.source_name: MPKV Rahuri, Krishi Darshani 2026 (Marathi diary; read from rendered page images)
all.notes: Spacing table on PDF p.137 (diary p.118). Bt duration not stated. Window start/end derived: 2nd week June start, 1st week July end.

sowing_window.text: Generally 10th to 30th June is optimum time for sowing in Central India and Telangana.

all_cicr.seed_rate_text: Seed per acre (450 g packets): 6 packets/acre for HDPS 90x15; 4 packets/acre for closer spacing 90x30 (converted: 6x0.45 kg x 2.471 = 6.7 kg/ha; 4x0.45x2.471 = 4.4 kg/ha)
all_cicr.spacing_cm: 90 x 15 (HDPS, shallow/red soils, 29,629 plants/acre); 90 x 30 (medium-deep to deep soils, 14,814 plants/acre)
all_cicr.sowing_trigger: Manual sowing may be taken up after receipt of 70 mm cumulative rainfall in 3 consecutive days.
all_cicr.source_name: ICAR-CICR Nagpur, Bulletin: High Density Planting System for cotton (English)
all_cicr.notes: For compact BG II hybrids under rainfed conditions (HDPS).

vidarbha.sowing_trigger: Sow after onset of monsoon with receipt of adequate rainfall (75 mm to 100 mm) in Vidarbha region; late sowing (10 to 15 July) results in 24% reduction in yield.
